$comment: specify-capability-rows 29.1: a quote line can name one of its product's variants by code (variantSku), like a lead line. A product picked onto a quote line asks the price resolver (POST /api/products/resolve-price, open to anyone who may read the product) for the unit price at the line's quantity and variant, and asks again when either changes; a price the user types stays theirs (nextcloud-vue CnChildRecordsField addFrom.resolve). The VAT rate stays the quote's own. The resolver answers 404 for a code the product does not carry. salesQuote 1.2.0 -> 1.3.0, salesQuoteLine 1.1.0 -> 1.2.0.

variantSku.title: Variant code
variantSku.description: The code of the product's variant this line is for. Empty means the product itself.
